title: Ego-Graph Module Public API
description: Contract for the ego-graph.js module exports. Describes the function signatures and their expected behavior.

initEgoGraph.description: Initialize the ego-graph module with the vis.Network instance. Must be called after createGraph().

applyEgoGraph.description: Set a new spotlight node: hide non-neighbors, show neighborhood, focus camera, open detail panel. Transitions to ego mode.

items.name: nodeId
items.description: ID of the node to spotlight

expandAll.description: Transition to full-graph mode: unhide all nodes/edges, restore physics, fit viewport. Transitions to full mode.

getSpotlightId.description: Return the current spotlight node ID, or null if in full mode.

pickRandomSpotlight.description: Select a random non-company node ID from the dataset. Does not apply the ego-graph — call applyEgoGraph() with the result.

returns.description: Node ID of the randomly selected non-company node
